topic: 离线网络更新工件的信任与失败边界
title: 交付离线更新包信任门禁：签名、完整暂存与验证后回退
review_note: 独立本地验收：参考产物通过，初始产物和典型错误实现未通过；真实集群和外部服务不在本轮执行范围。
body:
## 环境与初始材料
非root隔离Linux、Python3、OpenSSL3的Ed25519 pkeyutl能力。提供release.py骨架，验收生成source目录、release-id.txt、release-private.pem、trusted-public.pem与releases空目录。全部操作限定当前临时工作区，不部署服务，不处理用户真实配置。

## 操作任务
实现release.py三个命令：pack从source/与release-id.txt生成bundle/（payload、manifest.json、manifest.sig），用临时提供的Ed25519私钥调用真实OpenSSL签署清单原始字节；install仅使用trusted-public.pem验签并校验每个文件的路径/长度/SHA256、无多余文件与符号链接，再完整暂存到releases/<id>并原子切换current符号链接；activate <id>重新验签校验已存版本后切换，实现有验证的回退。任何拒绝返回2，已服务版本和既有release字节不能改变；成功返回0。不能执行payload、联网下载密钥或替换可信公钥。

## 提交产物
release.py完整程序；运行生成bundle签名工件、releases版本树和受控current入口。

### 工件契约
release-id只接受r1到r999。清单结构为{"release":"r1","files":[{"path":"nested/cache.json","size":12,"sha256":"64位小写摘要"}]}；签署清单文件原始字节。路径是/分隔的相对路径，各段只含ASCII字母/数字/下划线/点/短横，禁止空段、.和..，总长≤100。1–8个普通文件，每文件≤16384字节、合计≤65536；清单≤16384、签名≤1024。bundle仅有manifest.json、manifest.sig、payload三项。source/bundle/releases及payload不允许符号链接；current是唯一受控链接，目标为releases/<id>/payload。pack要求bundle尚不存在；install要求版本未存在。releases目录由环境创建，公私钥由验收临时提供，均非真实生产凭据。

## 验收方法
验收生成临时Ed25519密钥和动态配置文件，调用原生openssl独立验证pack签名与完整性；安装r1/r2并真实读取current指向的文件，再回退/恢复。新r3负例覆盖截断签名、内容篡改、未签名额外文件、payload符号链接、合法签名但路径穿越/重复清单、错误公钥；全部应保留当前指针与旧版本。旧版本被篡改后activate也必须拒绝。最后检查输入链接不会被打包以及无残留暂存目录。仅本地工件流转，不执行更新内容或改生产服务；签名不等同于恶意软件扫描或业务兼容性验收。

失败示例：只验签清单而不核对payload内容，会安装清单未变但文件已被替换的包；回退若不重新校验旧版本，也可能切回被篡改的内容。
rubric: 真实签名绑定完整清单和内容
拒绝越界/额外/链接工件且不改变已服务版本
暂存验证完成后切换，回退也重新验签验内容

test_files.checks/check.py:
import hashlib,json,os,pathlib,shutil,subprocess,sys,secrets
root=pathlib.Path.cwd();(root/'releases').mkdir();(root/'source/nested').mkdir(parents=True)
def native(args):subprocess.run(['openssl',*args],stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,check=True,timeout=3)
native(['genpkey','-algorithm','ED25519','-out','release-private.pem'])
native(['pkey','-in','release-private.pem','-pubout','-out','trusted-public.pem'])
public=(root/'trusted-public.pem').read_bytes()
def readonly_material():
    result={name:(root/name).read_bytes() for name in ('release-private.pem','trusted-public.pem','release-id.txt') if (root/name).is_file()}
    for p in (root/'source').rglob('*'):
        if p.is_symlink():result['source/'+p.relative_to(root/'source').as_posix()]=('link',os.readlink(p))
        elif p.is_file():result['source/'+p.relative_to(root/'source').as_posix()]=p.read_bytes()
    return result
def call(*args):
    original=readonly_material()
    code=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'release.py',*args],capture_output=True,timeout=6).returncode
    assert readonly_material()==original,'provided trust anchors, keys and source material must remain unchanged'
    return code
def resign():native(['pkeyutl','-sign','-inkey','release-private.pem','-rawin','-in','bundle/manifest.json','-out','bundle/manifest.sig'])
def snapshot():
    files={p.relative_to(root/'releases').as_posix():hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in (root/'releases').rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
    return os.readlink(root/'current') if (root/'current').is_symlink() else None,files
saved=[]
for rid in ('r1','r2'):
    content=('release='+rid+'\nnonce='+secrets.token_hex(12)+'\n').encode()
    if rid=='r1':content=content+b'x'*(16384-len(content))
    (root/'source/app.conf').write_bytes(content);(root/'source/nested/cache.json').write_text(json.dumps({'enabled':rid=='r2','nonce':secrets.token_hex(8)}));(root/'release-id.txt').write_text(rid)
    assert call('pack')==0
    m=json.loads((root/'bundle/manifest.json').read_text());assert m['release']==rid
    native(['pkeyutl','-verify','-pubin','-inkey','trusted-public.pem','-rawin','-in','bundle/manifest.json','-sigfile','bundle/manifest.sig'])
    # Verify pack completeness independently before using the apply implementation.
    entries={x['path']:x for x in m['files']};assert set(entries)=={'app.conf','nested/cache.json'}
    for name in entries:
        data=(root/'source'/name).read_bytes();assert (root/'bundle/payload'/name).read_bytes()==data
        assert entries[name]['size']==len(data) and entries[name]['sha256']==hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
    source_snapshot={p.relative_to(root/'source').as_posix():p.read_bytes() for p in (root/'source').rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
    assert call('install')==0 and os.readlink(root/'current')==f'releases/{rid}/payload'
    assert (root/'current/app.conf').read_bytes()==content
    assert all((root/'source'/name).read_bytes()==data for name,data in source_snapshot.items())
    shutil.copytree(root/'bundle',root/('saved-'+rid));saved.append(content);shutil.rmtree(root/'bundle')
assert call('activate','r1')==0 and (root/'current/app.conf').read_bytes()==saved[0]
assert call('activate','r2')==0 and (root/'current/app.conf').read_bytes()==saved[1]
stable=snapshot()
# Use a new signed release id so failures cannot be rejected merely as an existing release.
def reset_bundle():
    if (root/'bundle').exists():shutil.rmtree(root/'bundle')
    shutil.copytree(root/'saved-r2',root/'bundle');m=json.loads((root/'bundle/manifest.json').read_text());m['release']='r3';(root/'bundle/manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(m));resign()
def rejected():
    assert call('install')==2,'invalid transfer accepted'
    assert snapshot()==stable,'failed transfer changed serving pointer or stored release bytes'
reset_bundle();signature=(root/'bundle/manifest.sig').read_bytes();(root/'bundle/manifest.sig').write_bytes(signature[:-1]);rejected()
reset_bundle();(root/'bundle/payload/app.conf').write_bytes(b'changed same trust boundary');rejected()
reset_bundle();(root/'bundle/payload/unsigned.txt').write_text('not signed');rejected()
reset_bundle();(root/'bundle/payload/app.conf').unlink();(root/'bundle/payload/app.conf').symlink_to(root/'source/app.conf');rejected()
(root/'outside.txt').write_text('owned sentinel')
reset_bundle();m=json.loads((root/'bundle/manifest.json').read_text());m['files'][0]['path']='../../outside.txt';(root/'bundle/manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(m));resign();rejected();assert (root/'outside.txt').read_text()=='owned sentinel'
reset_bundle();m=json.loads((root/'bundle/manifest.json').read_text());m['files'].append(m['files'][0]);(root/'bundle/manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(m));resign();rejected()
reset_bundle();native(['genpkey','-algorithm','ED25519','-out','other-key.pem']);native(['pkey','-in','other-key.pem','-pubout','-out','trusted-public.pem']);rejected();(root/'trusted-public.pem').write_bytes(public)
# A root directory symlink is just as forbidden as a linked payload file.
for name in ('bundle','releases'):
    reset_bundle();location=root/name;held=root/('held-'+name);location.rename(held);location.symlink_to(held,target_is_directory=True)
    try:rejected()
    finally:location.unlink();held.rename(location)
reset_bundle();payload=root/'bundle/payload';held=root/'held-payload';payload.rename(held);payload.symlink_to(held,target_is_directory=True)
try:rejected()
finally:payload.unlink();held.rename(payload)
# Rollback itself must revalidate old bytes; merely trusting a release directory name is unsafe.
stored=root/'releases/r1/payload/app.conf';stored.write_bytes(b'corrupt old release');corrupt_snapshot=snapshot()
assert call('activate','r1')==2 and snapshot()==corrupt_snapshot
assert (root/'current/app.conf').read_bytes()==saved[1]
assert call('activate','../outside')==2 and snapshot()==corrupt_snapshot
# Pack must not read a linked input or publish half of an invalid transfer.
shutil.rmtree(root/'bundle');(root/'source/link').symlink_to(root/'trusted-public.pem');assert call('pack')==2 and not (root/'bundle').exists()
(root/'source/link').unlink()
source=root/'source';held=root/'held-source';source.rename(held);source.symlink_to(held,target_is_directory=True)
try:assert call('pack')==2 and not (root/'bundle').exists()
finally:source.unlink();held.rename(source)
for i in range(7):(root/'source'/('extra'+str(i))).write_text('one')
assert call('pack')==2 and not (root/'bundle').exists(),'9 files exceed inventory limit'
for i in range(7):(root/'source'/('extra'+str(i))).unlink()
(root/'source/app.conf').write_bytes(b'x'*16385)
assert call('pack')==2 and not (root/'bundle').exists(),'per-file bound must precede publication'
# Positive exact limits then one byte beyond aggregate limit: no small fixture shortcut.
shutil.rmtree(root/'source');(root/'source').mkdir();(root/'release-id.txt').write_text('r4')
for i in range(8):(root/'source'/('part'+str(i))).write_bytes(bytes([65+i])*8192)
assert call('pack')==0
manifest=json.loads((root/'bundle/manifest.json').read_text());assert len(manifest['files'])==8 and sum(e['size'] for e in manifest['files'])==65536
assert {e['path'] for e in manifest['files']}=={'part'+str(i) for i in range(8)}
for entry in manifest['files']:
    content=(root/'source'/entry['path']).read_bytes()
    assert (root/'bundle/payload'/entry['path']).read_bytes()==content
    assert entry['size']==len(content) and entry['sha256']==hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest()
native(['pkeyutl','-verify','-pubin','-inkey','trusted-public.pem','-rawin','-in','bundle/manifest.json','-sigfile','bundle/manifest.sig'])
shutil.rmtree(root/'bundle');(root/'source/part0').write_bytes(b'x'*8193)
assert call('pack')==2 and not (root/'bundle').exists(),'aggregate bytes must be bounded independently of each file'
assert not list((root/'releases').glob('.stage-*')) and not list(root.glob('.bundle-*'))
